thread:
Lina: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Quick thread to capture the live Qs and owners for follow-ups. I'll log owners and ETAs here.

Marco: Two quick asks from customers: 1) will Dedicated GA include a migration checklist? 2) can we export per-route cost breakdowns?

Lina: Migration checklist = yes, we'll publish it. Per-route cost export = planned as an analytics export feature; Product will scope.

Sofia: I'll own the migration checklist and put a template in the planning doc: https://internal.redwood/migrate/dedicated. Owner: @Sofia. ETA: 10 working days.

Diego: For cost exports, I'll coordinate with analytics to define the CSV fields (model_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, compute_ms, cost_est). Owner: @Diego. ETA: 2w.

Marco: Also asked about canary rollback behavior during a model variant rollout  what metrics trigger rollback?

Lina: Default is SLA breach (p50/p95 latency) or quality regression on eval set. Product will publish the thresholds; teams can override per-rollout.

Sofia: I'll add the rollout thresholds to the rollout guide. Owner: @Sofia. ETA: 1w.

Diego: Ops question: can we get a sample log line for streaming responses with function-calls so security can review?

Lina: Yes  we'll include redaction guidance. I'll ask infra to add snippet. Owner: @Lina. ETA: 3d.

ops-bot: Note: post-ah survey live: https://internal.redwood/surveys/ah-2167890123  please confirm owners by Friday.

Marco: Marketing asked for a 1-line customer-facing blurb about Dedicated latency guarantees. I'll draft and post.

Lina: Thanks. Action summary below  react with :white_check_mark: if correct.

- Migration checklist + template: owner @Sofia  ETA 10d.
- Per-route cost export spec: owner @Diego + Analytics  ETA 2w.
- Rollout thresholds in guide: owner @Sofia  ETA 1w.
- Streaming/function-call log sample + redaction guidance: owner @Lina  ETA 3d.
- 1-line marketing blurb for latency guarantees: owner @Marco  ETA EOD today.

Sofia: Adding a small follow-up request  can we schedule a sync with security on redaction rules next Tue? I'll send a calendar invite.

Lina: Sounds good  please include infra and product.

Marco: I'll add the customer question notes to the sales playbook when the checklist lands.

Lina: If anyone else has follow-ups from the live Q&A that didn't make it in, drop them here or DM me. Thanks all. :party_popper:
